parsed_json.up: Select the first 500 activity measurements for monoamine oxidase B (CHEMBL221). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL221. Join compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Sort by potency ascending (standard_value ascending). Limit to 500 rows.
